Palette: brick red and rust, pale grey stone, blue-black slate, raked pale sand and dark iron; on the day of the Tournament, an even veil of pale grey-white high cloud over the whole sky, never a blue sky, and a cool silvery light with soft shadows, the clans’ banners the only bright colours; once the breach is open, the cold black of ink and a thin cold white light; in the burning streets, orange and red flames, embers, black smoke and soot-blackened brick; at dawn, a grey light of ash and thin smoke. The breach is a tall jagged tear in the air, pure black inside like cold ink with no stars and no depth, its edges fraying into black ink and rimmed with a thin cold white light; black ink seeps from it and stains stone and sand. Never purple, violet or magenta anywhere, never a purple glow. Never the Lion’s motifs: no Gothic or pointed arches, pointed windows or slender spires, no conical or pointed tower roofs, no aqueduct or viaduct, no timber framing, no fairy-tale castle, no green forest or meadows, no red-and-gold scheme or hangings, the Lion’s own banner among the clans’ banners being the only red-and-gold. Never the Bear’s: no grey granite, no snow or ice, no mines, no fur-and-timber buildings. Never the Dragon’s: no pale limestone peaks, no sea of clouds, no verdigris bronze, no bells, no pines. Never the Scorpion’s: no desert or dunes, no ochre mud brick or clay plaster, no flat roofs, no lattice screens, no palm trees. No castle, fortress, monastery, town or city anywhere in view, even far away on the horizon, unless the staging names it. The Shadows’ corruption is black like cold, frozen ink: never purple, violet or magenta, no purple glow. No banners, flags or emblems unless the staging names them. Each clan keeps its own sign: the Bear clan’s people, camps and banners show a bear; the Raven clan’s people, camps and banners show a raven; the Dragon clan’s people, camps and banners show a dragon; the Wolf clan’s people, camps and banners show a wolf; the Scorpion clan’s people, camps and banners show a scorpion; the Phoenix clan’s people, camps and banners show a phoenix; the Serpent clan’s people, camps and banners show a serpent; other banners mix the signs of several clans.
